text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I caught the scent of the sun, and 
sure enough, hello there, Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Smell good"... you mean me...!? Do I 
smell weird or something!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed it is. Like an easterly breeze 
calming the roar of the tide.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Is it really noticeable enough to 
bother you that much?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san is truly like a swift gust of 
wind. It is simply impossible not to 
notice her.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I suspect that is precisely what everyone 
at this academy is thinking.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, maybe it's 'cause I was staring at 
Golshi grilling fish on that charcoal 
stove earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaaahhh, what do I dooo...! I have plans 
to meet the Prez, too!! I don't wanna 
smell like grilled fishhh!
